purchases.title: How Good People Drift into Disaster
purchases.summary: The smallest cluster and the sharpest. Six essays using popular culture the way a theologian uses a parable. Girard's mimetic desire runs beneath every system. 'The Choices We Call Necessity' — the Devil Wears Prada essay — is the sharpest piece in the corpus: Hannah Arendt meets Miranda Priestly, and the argument is that moral drift doesn't announce itself. You just stop noticing what you're becoming.
